reason: Extreme-heat protocol: the organisers redrew the stage on the afternoon of 2026-09-05, cutting Palma del Río -> Córdoba from 189.7 km to 110.2 km. At km 52 of the original course the race leaves for the CO-3402 towards Santa María de Trassierra, which removes the western loop through Villaviciosa and with it the original climbs.
source: Vuelta a España organiser communiqué, 2026-09-05 (as recorded in predictions/stage_15/scenarios.json day_key_note)
